privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: At Makzn7, we respect your privacy. This page explains what information we collect when you visit our website or reach out to us about a production, what we do with it, and the rights you have over it.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
sections.content: We only collect what you choose to share with us — usually your name, email, phone number, company, and a brief about your production or project when you fill in the contact form. We also collect basic technical data such as device type, browser, and pages visited to help us improve the experience.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.content: We use your information to reply to your inquiry, prepare quotes, plan productions, and follow up on collaborations. Aggregated analytics help us understand which work resonates and refine how the site is built. We do not sell your data, and we do not share it with third parties for marketing.

sections.title: 3. Project Imagery & Credits
sections.content: Photos and case studies published on this site belong to Makzn7 or to clients who granted us permission to share them. If you appear in any imagery or believe a credit is missing or incorrect, contact us and we will review the request promptly.

sections.title: 4. Cookies & Analytics
sections.content: We use a small number of cookies to keep the site running smoothly, remember your language preference, and measure traffic anonymously. You can disable cookies in your browser, though some parts of the experience may behave differently.

sections.title: 5. Data Security
sections.content: We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect the information you share with us. No system on the internet is fully immune to risk, but we limit access to your data to the team members who actually need it to respond to you.

sections.title: 6. Your Rights
sections.content: You can ask us at any time to access, correct, or delete the personal information we hold about you, or to stop using it for a specific purpose. Just send us a message through the contact section and we will respond within a reasonable timeframe.

sections.title: 7. Changes to This Policy
sections.content: We may update this Privacy Policy as our services or the law evolve. When we do, we will revise the date above and, when changes are significant, highlight them clearly on the site.

sections.title: 8. Contact Us
sections.content: If you have any questions about this policy or how we handle your data, reach out through the contact form on this site and our team will get back to you.
